server.note: ready_ms is the figure that Vite printed. The checks were driven by the Playwright library from the repository root (phase-2-probe.mjs), because each row needs its own context with touch, viewport or WebKit, and the MCP browser tools do not set these. Full per-variant values are in phase-2-probe-results.json. AC-2.16 and the open-file sweep were driven a second time after two driver errors were fixed, with no source change between the runs (newest source file 14:46, first run 15:09). The first driver error counted the file chooser of the photo import. The second expected a filechooser event from the real showOpenFilePicker of Chromium. Server stopped: doctor.mjs stop reported free_after true.
